topic: Global Top Companies by Market Capitalization and Revenue

interpretations.label: Market Capitalization
interpretations.description: Total dollar market value of a company's outstanding shares of stock
caveats: Subject to currency exchange rate volatility

interpretations.label: Annual Revenue
interpretations.description: Total amount of income generated by the sale of goods or services related to primary operations
caveats: Does not reflect operational expenses, debt, or net profitability

knownRisks: Incomplete historical data points for specific calendar years
Inconsistent fiscal year-end reporting dates across international entities
